description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the CreateSubscription class, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization with all and minimal fields.

classes.name: CreateSubscriptionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior and immutability of the CreateSubscription class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of CreateSubscription are effectively immutable and that fields are safely unmodifiable collections.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that CreateSubscription correctly implements hashCode() and equals() methods.

methods.name: toJsonWithAllFieldsSet
methods.description: Tests serialization of CreateSubscription to JSON when all fields are populated.

methods.name: toJsonWithOnlyRequiredFieldsSet
methods.description: Tests serialization of CreateSubscription to JSON when only required fields are set.

methods.name: fromJsonWithAllFieldsSet
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON with all fields present into a CreateSubscription object.

methods.name: fromJsonWithOnlyRequiredFieldsSet
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON with only required fields into a CreateSubscription object.
